title: pilosella floribunda subsp. hylaeophila
intro: Pilosella floribunda subsp. hylaeophila, commonly known as the Hylae's mouse-ear hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella floribunda subsp. hylaeophila include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
